_readme: THE BOARD (owner ruling 2026-11-17, docs/projects/active/ONE_BOARD_PLAN.md): the ONLY place a project's status is written.
Other trackers (TODO, plan headers, the roadmap, memory, index pages) point here and never restate it. Change a project's line
in the same commit as the work that changes it. Activity, walks owed and production state are derived by scripts/owner-brief.mjs.
goals    = ids from the goals list. A project whose goals are all 'after' goals sits in the After launch lane.
lane     = now | next | later. Now holds at most three, in the owner's order (order = 1, 2, 3); the owner sets it.
phase    = Planning | Drawing | Asks to rule | Building | Walk owed | Ready to release | Live | Parked. Live = done.
stage    = 'Now: … → Next: …' in words. next = the single next action. remains = what is left, one or two sentences.
waitsOn  = projects that must be done before the NEXT step can start (a Now project may have none open).
finishesAfter = projects that must be done before this one can FINISH (sequencing only).
youOwe   = steps only the owner can take (rulings, dashboard steps, approvals). Never walks: those come from the ledger.
checked  = false until the project's line has been truth-checked against its plan body, the ledger and git.
files    = plan-file basenames whose history is the project's activity. ledger = words in its QA ledger section titles.
roadmap  = optional: the PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md §2 item texts that cover this project's WHOLE scope. The script warns when a row's Status disagrees with the phase.
state    = open | parked | closed. Parked needs parked: { since, reason } in the owner's words. Only the owner parks or closes.
Words on the board are product-owner English: no file paths, hashes or internal codes beyond a § walk number.

Stage 1 done 17 Nov: the test-mode trial worked (every Stripe cost landed on the club, only our fee on us; your go), and you chose to keep the rates families see, with our fee becoming what is left after Stripe's cost (logged). Stage 2 built 18 Nov: new club accounts pay Stripe its own fees and we take only our margin (stored on each payment); the three dev clubs' old accounts take no new payments and are replaced through Set up payouts again (your yes 18 Nov), UAT Rep Club only after the payout test's payout steps (your yes 18 Nov: split the pass). Stage 4 built 18 Nov (before Stage 3, your order): we no longer bill clubs for Stripe's extras, so the monthly Stripe-fee invoice, its list, banner and admin panel are gone; your three calls taken (address before payouts kept, the two fee tables dropped, the Bookkeeping row kept for history). Stage 5 done 18 Nov, except what waits for Stage 3: the payments terms rewritten for this model as v0.2 (Stripe charges the club directly, our fee is only our part, we bill nothing else; you approved it 18 Nov), the next privacy policy drafted without the retired fee invoice (to publish with the terms), one new line in Before you set up payouts (Stripe's own terms and prices apply; a negative balance is the club's), and the help rewritten. Stage 3 built on dev 18 Nov (your rulings: fix only what is off; dispute fees booked; Stripe's later fees matched to their payment once a day; the payments terms narrowed so our fee comes back only on a debit that fails before it clears): a foreign card's extra, a dispute's fee, Stripe's later $5 and $15 fees, and the fee a family paid on a lost dispute now reach the club's books; Canadian payments read as before. Stage 3 built and reviewed 18 Nov (the books match what Stripe takes; terms narrowed, your yes); your walk for Stages 2–5 passed 41/41 and you closed it on 18 Nov; it found one small gap (a dispute that arrived a second before its payment landed was dropped silently), fixed and committed the same day and called complete, so nothing is owed from the walk. Before switch-on: ask your accountant whether our fee is taxable (the question list is ready). Owed: the full payout test; before switch-on, your call on who pays the processing fee by default (you left it for then, 18 Nov). Built 17 Nov: the refund policy is required (no pay page without one) and every agreement to the terms is kept for good; setting up payouts in Québec is refused. Still before the terms publish: the tax on our fee (GST/HST Stage 5); then live payouts set up in Stripe and your switch-on. Money-services check done: no registration needed as built.
